module sorted_lists

public function merge_unique(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge_unique(left: [], right: []) is []
  example: merge_unique(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

  let merged be left.append_all(right).sorted()
  let unique be merged.distinct()
  return unique
end

test "merging two empty lists gives an empty list"
  check merge_unique(left: [], right: []) is []
end

module sorted_lists

public function merge_unique(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge_unique(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  example: merge_unique(left: [], right: []) is []

  let result: List of Integer be []
  let mutable i be 0
  let mutable j be 0

  repeat until i is at least left.length() and j is at least right.length()
    if left.at(i) is less than right.at(j) then
      if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not left.at(i) then
        set result to result.append(left.at(i))
      end
      set i to i + 1
    otherwise if right.at(j) is less than left.at(i) then
      if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not right.at(j) then
        set result to result.append(right.at(j))
      end
      set j to j + 1
    otherwise
      if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not left.at(i) then
        set result to result.append(left.at(i))
      end
      set i to i + 1
      set j to j + 1
    end
  end

  repeat until i is at least left.length()
    if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not left.at(i) then
      set result to result.append(left.at(i))
    end
    set i to i + 1
  end

  repeat until j is at least right.length()
    if result.is_empty() or result.last() is not right.at(j) then
      set result to result.append(right.at(j))
    end
    set j to j + 1
  end

  return result
end

test "merge_unique handles two empty lists"
  check merge_unique(left: [], right: []) is []
end
